description: PB-37 is the Regional Transport Office serving the Phillour sub-division of the Jalandhar district in Punjab. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and local transport law enforcement. It is a critical administrative hub for the residents of the Phillour and Goraya areas within the Jalandhar region.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Phillour, District Jalandhar, Punjab
